title: Eclampsia at 35 weeks (24F)
provenance: Vignette written 2026-09-30; expected answers quoted from the MOH Training Manual on Hypertensive Disorders in Pregnancy 2018.

intake.complaint: Fitted once at home 30 minutes ago, severe headache and blurred vision.
intake.history: First pregnancy, leg swelling for a week.

triage.note: GCS 13 - MTS p7 L2; post-ictal eclampsia may justify L1.
